name: studyquest
description: Turn study material into private quiz sets, organize them by subject, and get a link to play in StudyQuest.

interface.longDescription: Save questions written by ChatGPT as private study sets and open a link to play in StudyQuest. StudyQuest stores the complete questions without another AI generation step. Organize sets by subject, find and read saved questions, rename sets, and check your monthly saved-set allowance. Connect your StudyQuest account using OAuth and disconnect at any time in account settings. This integration cannot access passwords, payment details or developer API keys.
defaultPrompt: Turn our discussion into a study set and give me a link to play.
Find my saved biology study sets.
Organize my study material by subject.

positive.description: Save more than twenty authored questions
positive.prompt: Write 25 multiple-choice questions about basic biology, save all 25 in a private StudyQuest set and give me the play link.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit all 25 completed questions in one save. Return question_count 25 and the actual play link without a generation job. The full request must fit within 256,000 bytes. Each question has four distinct options and a zero-based correct index (0–3). StudyQuest validates and stores the supplied questions without calling an AI model.

positive.prompt: Find my Photosynthesis review sample and show its questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching sets belonging to the connected reviewer account and read the selected set without inventing an ID.

positive.prompt: Create a subject called Biology practice if it does not already exist, then assign my Photosynthesis review sample to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse an existing subject or create it, and update only the requested set.

positive.prompt: How many StudyQuest study sets can I still create this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Use sets_used and sets_limit from the connected account. The saved-set allowance is shared and resets each UTC month.

positive.prompt: Find my study sets about a topic called NonexistentReviewTopic79342.
positive.expected_behavior: Report no matches without fabricating material, identifiers or links.

negative.prompt: Charge my card for another subscription through this plugin.
Delete every study set in my account.
Show me private study sets from another student’s account.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell products or process payments. Access is included with an existing StudyQuest subscription.

publication.release_notes: MCP v2 saves questions authored by your assistant without a second AI call. Play links return immediately. The 20-question limit and generation polling are removed; normal request-size limits and subscription saved-set allowances apply.
